> Sorry @lebaphi - were you suggesting another strategy, or explaining what you did?

Hi @IanMayo, I just explain we have 2 ways to do this, first one is handle it by javascript, and he second one is using the built-in option. So I choose the second one but we got an issue of the space. So let me try with the first one, it may not "official" but the result will be the same to what we did when adding the prop `fitContent` to the TextArea component.

Good strategy - thanks :-)

I wonder if we're doing some styling that is _breaking_ the `expand height` in json-editor.

I think nope, because we just try to set the height of only the textarea element like the built-in option does. But we will test it careful before release, so no worries :)

issues.title: When reading a Collaborative Working document I would like to see all text
issues.body:
The JSON-Editor control shows text-area blocks with a scroll-bar.

This means people viewing the document have to use scroll-bars to view large blocks of text.

It would be better if the whole paragraph was displayed
